summary: On Linux, run-radios.sh hands off to tools/radios_launch.py. That script rebuilds build/radios with CMake (or runs it inside the Flatpak SDK when system libraries are missing) and checks the config with `radios --check-config`. Under an fcntl operation lock it then does the first-run install: a staged SDBASE store and credentials, published crash-safely through setup-pending.json with os.link and directory fsyncs, all under umask 077 and 0600/uid checks. Next it starts or adopts the installation's own service: a start_new_session child that writes a 0600 log and service.json, and is identified by the /proc boot_id, start ticks and argv suffix plus the instance UUID and the source digest. Finally it execv's the GUI. The C app never reads service.json. data.c spawns `python_command radios_database.py start` (15 s timeout), admin_ui.c spawns radios_reliability.py, reset_ui.c relaunches through `sh -c setsid run-radios.sh`, and window.c/recovery.c/data_client.c share credentials.json, gui.lock, the outbox locks and the source-digest algorithm with the tools. Almost every primitive is Linux-only (fcntl, /proc, pidfd_send_signal, O_NOFOLLOW/O_DIRECTORY/O_NONBLOCK, getuid/mode bits, dir fsync, os.sync, os.link, execv, flatpak). Several also fail silently on Windows: os.open is text mode without O_BINARY, start_new_session is ignored, os.kill means TerminateProcess, SO_REUSEADDR lets two listeners share a port, CRT O_APPEND is not inherited, junctions get past is_symlink, and fsync needs a write handle. Windows design: RadioS.exe itself is the entry point. Before building its window it spawns `python -E -s -B -X utf8 tools\radios_database.py ... ensure`, a new subcommand that is exactly the launcher's init+start block and is also used in-process on Linux. Errors are shown in a dialog, and all lifecycle logic stays in Python. A new tools/radios_platform.py shim (stdlib + ctypes) provides: flock via LockFileEx at a byte offset shared with C and sdbase; binary, non-inheritable, share-delete no-follow opens; ACL privacy using CPython's own 0o700 SDDL with owner and allow-ACE checks; MoveFileExW replace and no-replace publish with retry; process identity from the creation FILETIME plus the NtQueryInformationProcess command line, with a constant boot id so _owned is unchanged; detached spawn with CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP, CREATE_NO_WINDOW and breakaway, logging to an append-only handle; and graceful stop through the named event Local\RadioS-SDBASE-<instance> and a pinned process handle (TerminateProcess only for our own child or an explicit `stop --force`). The bundled embeddable Python gets a ._pth containing ..\..\tools and tzdata. `python_command=python3` maps to runtime\python\python.exe and PATH is never searched (Store alias). UTF-8 stdio is mandatory because the GUI decodes helper output as UTF-8. Dev launchers run-radios/run-database .cmd/.ps1 keep the Linux subcommands; radios_launch builds with Ninja and runs the exe without execv. The Flatpak SDK files are Linux-only. The hardware check asks `RadioS.exe --audio-inventory` (WASAPI) instead of pactl. radios_package gains a deterministic portable Windows zip (bin\ DLL closure found by a PE import parser, GTK data, runtime\python, empty data\) and a per-user NSIS installer.
files_touched: tools/radios_sdk.py (Linux-only guard; excluded from Windows package)
CMakeLists.txt (otomasyon_e2e and analiz EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL targets - build area)
src/app/main.c (cross-area: ensure step, --audio-inventory, --wait-pid, GUI stop event)
src/ui/data.c (cross-area: spawn rules, timeout, no flatpak)
src/core/data_client.c (cross-area: POSIX database_file compare, privacy rule)
key_decisions: Windows entry point is RadioS.exe itself. Before creating its window it spawns one Python helper `radios_database.py ... ensure` (new subcommand = radios_launch.py L110-125: first-run init + owned service start under operation_lock). Lifecycle logic stays in Python, and Linux calls the same ensure_installation() in-process.

One shim, tools/radios_platform.py (stdlib + ctypes), replaces fcntl, /proc, pidfd, getuid/mode checks, O_NOFOLLOW/O_DIRECTORY/O_NONBLOCK, os.sync, start_new_session and dir fsync. Its POSIX branch keeps today's exact behaviour.

flock emulation = LockFileEx on a single byte at FLOCK_OFFSET=0x7FFFFFFF00000000 (length 1). C platform.c, sdbase/_platform.py and the tools shim must use the identical range; a contract test enforces it.

Process identity on Windows = (boot_id 'win32' constant, start_ticks = creation FILETIME in 100 ns, argv from NtQueryInformationProcess(ProcessCommandLineInformation) + CommandLineToArgvW). _owned() is unchanged. The GetTickCount64 boot time is informational only, because it drifts with clock changes.

Detached service: CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP|CREATE_NO_WINDOW, plus CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB with fallback; stdin=DEVNULL; stdout/stderr go to a FILE_APPEND_DATA-only log handle; close_fds=True. A bind pre-check detects excluded port ranges (WSAEACCES).

Graceful stop: serve creates the manual-reset event Local\RadioS-SDBASE-<instance> and polls it every 0.2 s loop turn. stop pins the process with OpenProcess(SYNCHRONIZE|QUERY_LIMITED|TERMINATE), re-verifies identity, then SetEvent. Default stop never kills (documented guarantee); the new `stop --force` uses TerminateProcess.

Privacy uses explicit protected DACLs instead of trusting the profile ACL (this machine's Desktop grants CodexSandboxUsers read on credentials.json). Dirs use CPython's 0o700 SDDL D:P(A;OICI;FA;;;SY)(A;OICI;FA;;;BA)(A;OICI;FA;;;OW); files are created private with SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES. The check is owner = current user and no data-rights allow-ACE outside {user, SY, BA, OW}. FAT/exFAT fails closed for config\ and data\database-service\. ensure hardens data\ and config\ on first run; there is a repair-permissions command.

Every os.open gets O_BINARY (text-mode fds would corrupt .sdb copies in _publish/_digest). Every text write gets encoding='utf-8' and newline='\n'. Every helper reconfigures stdio to UTF-8, because data.c and admin_ui.c decode helper output as UTF-8.

Replace = MoveFileExW(REPLACE_EXISTING|WRITE_THROUGH) with a bounded retry on errors 5/32/33. Publish-without-replace = MoveFileExW(WRITE_THROUGH) (ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS → FileExistsError), which also works on exFAT. Dir fsync and os.sync are no-ops. fsync opens with write access.

Bundled embeddable CPython goes in runtime\python with a generated python3XX._pth (python3XX.zip, ., tzdata.zip, ..\..\tools). Windows interpreter flags are always -E -s -B -X utf8. python_command 'python3'/'python' maps to runtime\python\python.exe; paths are root-relative; PATH is never searched (Store alias).
BoundedHTTPServer must not set SO_REUSEADDR on Windows (two listeners could share 127.0.0.1:8000); SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE only if an immediate restart still works.

JSON paths crossing languages (credentials.json and setup-pending.json database_file) are stored in POSIX form via as_posix(). The source digest sorts by name string with a case-sensitive .py filter, to match C strcmp.

storage.ini on Windows accepts X:\ or UNC absolute normalized backslash paths and rejects drive/share roots, '/', \\?\, ADS ':' and reserved names. Link checks are junction-aware (st_reparse_tag name-surrogate bit). Comparisons use normcase. C must mirror this.

Dev launchers: run-radios.cmd/.ps1 → radios_launch.py (Ninja build, last-good fallback, MSYS2 PATH for DLLs, subprocess.run instead of execv). run-database.cmd/.ps1 offer the same subcommands plus ensure/repair-permissions. The .cmd files are primary, CRLF, and strip the trailing backslash of %~dp0.

Linux-only and excluded from Windows: run-radios-sdk.sh, radios_sdk.py, flatpak branches, otomasyon build.sh (→ CMake targets otomasyon_e2e and analiz). radios_hardware_check keeps its report schema but uses `RadioS.exe --audio-inventory` (WASAPI enumeration in C) instead of pactl.

Packaging: new 'windows' kind = deterministic portable zip RadioS\{bin (RadioS.exe + DLL closure via a pure-Python PE import parser + gspawn helpers), lib, share, etc, runtime\python, tools, database\SDBASE, config, assets, docs, empty data\*}, verified like the tarballs (plus case-folded duplicate and reserved-name checks), with per-kind size limits. Optional per-user NSIS installer to $LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\RadioS (Program Files is incompatible with root-relative writable data\ and config\). It stops the service before upgrade and never touches user data.
risks: The lock byte range or lock semantics could differ between C, sdbase and the tools shim. Mutual exclusion would then silently disappear (restore under an open GUI, two services).
C may open lock files with inheritable handles. Children then keep the file object, so gui.lock appears held after the GUI exits.
Any raw os.open without O_BINARY corrupts binary DB copies (CRLF/Ctrl-Z translation). Mitigate by banning raw os.open in tools.

ACL privacy false negatives (inherited foreign ACEs, copied installs, FAT/exFAT) block first run unless ensure_private_tree and repair-permissions work well. Elevated vs non-elevated runs change ownership and process access.
Excluded port ranges (Hyper-V/WSL/Docker) make 127.0.0.1:8000 unbindable with WSAEACCES. SO_REUSEADDR on Windows allows double binding.
ProcessCommandLineInformation (ntdll) can be denied (integrity mismatch, security software), which makes the own service look 'foreign' and blocks launches.
Without breakaway rights the service dies with job-wrapped parents (VS Code terminal, Task Scheduler). Task Scheduler's default 72 h limit would kill a 24/7 RadioS.exe.
data.c's 15 s helper timeout vs the 60 s Python start budget. Windows is slower (Defender, no-bytecode imports), so the GUI may report failure while the service still starts.

Python version mismatch: the copy has 3.14.8 embeddable without a ._pth, the lead decided 3.13. The code needs ≥3.12.4 (private mkdir 0o700) and tzdata. Dev MSYS2 python also needs tzdata, or even ZoneInfo('UTC') fails.
A stale Linux config\credentials.json in the Windows copy (no DB beside it) makes the first Windows launch fail; its tokens should be treated as exposed (its ACL grants CodexSandboxUsers read).
The dev copy lives on the Desktop: OneDrive placeholders/sync locks and Controlled Folder Access can block DB writes and renames.
Package size: MSYS2 FFmpeg/GTK/Adwaita exceed today's MAX_FILE/MAX_FILES limits. Every DLL dependency must be resolved or startup fails on clean machines.
gui_backend_coverage and islev_envanteri tests fail on Windows until sdbase imports without fcntl.
Graceful logoff/shutdown of the service is best-effort (it is terminated like any process); SDBASE crash safety is the real guarantee.
cross_area_dependencies: platform.c (C) and sdbase/_platform.py must use the same flock emulation (LockFileEx, offset 0x7FFFFFFF00000000, length 1, SH/EX/NB/UN semantics, unlock before close) as tools/radios_platform.py.

platform.c and sdbase/_platform.py must use the same privacy rule and SDDL (owner = token user or BA when elevated; allow-ACEs only for user/SY/BA/OW; private dir/file SDDL as in CPython 3.13) for credentials.json, data/database-service, the outbox, backups and logs.
C opens (gui.lock, outbox .lock and JSON, credentials.json reads) must be non-inheritable, FILE_SHARE_DELETE, no-follow and binary.

C config.c/data.c/admin_ui.c must resolve python_command with the same rule ('python3'/'python' → <root>\runtime\python\python.exe, else a root-relative/absolute .exe, never PATH) and prepend -E -s -B -X utf8.

C spawners must use CREATE_NO_WINDOW and pass no inheritable handles except the pipes. The data.c start timeout should be ≥ 75 s. admin_ui.c should show reliability's new `command_line` instead of g_shell_quote.

main.c on Windows: run `ensure` before radios_window_new unless passive, smoke or RADIOS_SKIP_ENSURE (dialog on failure, exit 1). Add `--audio-inventory` (JSON), `--wait-pid` for reset relaunch, AttachConsole for passive output, root discovery via GetModuleFileNameW, and graceful quit via the console ctrl handler plus the named event Local\RadioS-GUI-<pid>.
reset_ui.c on Windows: relaunch RadioS.exe itself (GetCommandLineW minus --project-root, --wait-pid, breakaway fallback) instead of sh/setsid/run-radios.sh.

data_client.c: compare credentials database_file with '/'-normalised relative paths; installed_source_digest must keep byte-order name sorting and a case-sensitive .py suffix (Python side changed to match).

storage_locations.c must implement the identical Windows storage path rules (drive/UNC absolute, no '/', no roots, no ADS/\\?\/reserved names, junction-aware link check, normcase plain check) and harden marker folders with the private DACL.

sdbase: runtime_version.source_digest must use the same ordering/filter; api_server.BoundedHTTPServer allow_reuse_address=False on Windows; importable without fcntl; backup._fsync_tree/_publish_absent/_copy_file Windows-safe; no persistent file handles (or Store.close()); Windows-safe directory fsync.
WASAPI audio area: read-only endpoint enumeration (IMMDeviceEnumerator, all states, friendly name, enumerator, form factor, mix format, mute) exposed via `RadioS.exe --audio-inventory`.

Build/CMake area: application manifest (activeCodePage UTF-8, PerMonitorV2, longPathAware) on every exe incl. e2e/analiz; CMake targets otomasyon_e2e and analiz (EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL); Ninja generator; UTF-8 path handling for design/reference/tasarrım; CTest WORKING_DIRECTORY not /tmp; Python3_EXECUTABLE with tzdata.
platform_api_needs: Python radios_platform.flock(fd_or_file, operation:int) -> None: LOCK_SH=1/EX=2/NB=4/UN=8; Windows LockFileEx/UnlockFileEx on byte FLOCK_OFFSET=0x7FFFFFFF00000000 (length 1); ERROR_LOCK_VIOLATION → BlockingIOError(EWOULDBLOCK); ERROR_NOT_LOCKED ignored on unlock; POSIX fcntl.flock.

Python radios_platform.open_nofollow(path, flags, mode=0o600, *, private=False) -> int fd: POSIX os.open(flags|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC); Windows CreateFileW(FILE_SHARE_READ|WRITE|DELETE, FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT, private SD when creating) → a name-surrogate reparse tag raises OSError(ELOOP) → msvcrt.open_osfhandle (binary, non-inheritable); O_EXCL→CREATE_NEW, O_CREAT→OPEN_ALWAYS.
Python radios_platform.open_log_append(path) -> int fd: Windows handle with FILE_APPEND_DATA|SYNCHRONIZE|READ_CONTROL only (atomic appends in the child), no-follow, private and owner checked.
Python radios_platform.is_link(path_or_stat) -> bool: S_ISLNK or (st_reparse_tag & 0x20000000), so junctions count as links.

Python radios_platform.is_private(path_or_fd, *, directory=False, exact_file_mode=True) -> bool / owned_by_current_user(path_or_fd) -> bool: POSIX uid + mode rules as today; Windows GetSecurityInfo owner == token user (or BA if elevated), non-NULL DACL, no allow-ACE with data rights for SIDs outside {user, S-1-5-18, S-1-5-32-544, S-1-3-4}, volume must support persistent ACLs.

Python radios_platform.make_private(path_or_fd, directory=False), make_private_dir(path, parents=False, exist_ok=True), private_mkstemp(dir, prefix, suffix) -> (fd, name), ensure_private_tree(path): Windows SetNamedSecurityInfoW(DACL|PROTECTED_DACL) with 'D:P(A;OICI;FA;;;SY)(A;OICI;FA;;;BA)(A;OICI;FA;;;OW)' (dirs) / 'D:P(A;;FA;;;SY)(A;;FA;;;BA)(A;;FA;;;OW)' (files), applied only when owned by the current user; POSIX chmod 0700/0600.

Python radios_platform.replace(src, dst, timeout=2.0) (MoveFileExW REPLACE_EXISTING|WRITE_THROUGH, retry 5/32/33), publish_noreplace(src, dst) (POSIX os.link; Windows MoveFileExW WRITE_THROUGH without replace → FileExistsError), unlink(path, missing_ok, timeout) and rmtree(path) with retry, fsync_file(path) (write-access handle), fsync_dir(path) (Windows no-op), sync() (Windows no-op).

Python radios_platform.process_identity(pid) -> (boot_id, start_ticks, argv) | None: Windows OpenProcess(QUERY_LIMITED|SYNCHRONIZE); exited → None; start_ticks = str(creation FILETIME); argv = NtQueryInformationProcess(60) + CommandLineToArgvW; boot_id 'win32'. boot_time_iso() is informational only.

Python class radios_platform.PinnedProcess: open(pid) -> PinnedProcess|None (OpenProcess SYNCHRONIZE|QUERY_LIMITED|TERMINATE; POSIX pidfd_open), start_ticks(), alive(), wait(seconds)->bool, signal_term(instance) (Windows OpenEventW+SetEvent on Local\RadioS-SDBASE-<instance>; POSIX pidfd SIGTERM), terminate() (TerminateProcess / SIGKILL), close().

Python radios_platform.create_stop_event(instance) -> handle (CreateEventW manual-reset, refuses ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS), stop_event_is_set(handle) -> bool (WaitForSingleObject(h,0)), stop_event_name(instance) -> 'Local\\RadioS-SDBASE-'+instance.

Python radios_platform.spawn_detached(argv, *, cwd, env, log_fd) -> Popen: POSIX start_new_session=True; Windows creationflags CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP|CREATE_NO_WINDOW|CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB, retried without breakaway on PermissionError; stdin DEVNULL; close_fds=True.

Python radios_platform.python_argv(python_command, project_root) -> list[str] (resolution rule + '-E','-s','-B','-X','utf8' on Windows), display_command(argv) -> str (shlex.join / subprocess.list2cmdline), configure_stdio_utf8(), no_proxy_opener() (urllib ProxyHandler({})).

Python radios_platform.iter_processes() -> iterator of (pid, image_path, argv|None) via Toolhelp32 + QueryFullProcessImageNameW + command line (POSIX /proc); request_graceful_exit(pid) -> bool (SetEvent Local\RadioS-GUI-<pid>, else WM_CLOSE to the pid's top-level windows); install_warnings(root) -> list[str]; acl_supported(path) -> bool.
C radios_platform_flock(int fd, int op, GError **error) -> gboolean: same byte range and semantics as the Python shims (G_IO_ERROR_WOULD_BLOCK on NB contention).

C radios_platform_open_nofollow(const char *utf8_path, int flags, int mode, gboolean private_create) -> int: non-inheritable, binary, FILE_SHARE_READ|WRITE|DELETE, final reparse point → errno ELOOP, private SD on create.

C radios_platform_path_is_private(const char *utf8_path, gboolean directory) / radios_platform_fd_is_private(int fd, gboolean directory) -> gboolean, plus radios_platform_make_private_dir(const char *utf8_path, GError**): identical rule and SDDL to the Python shims.

C radios_platform_python_argv(const RadioSConfig *config, GError **error) -> gchar** (resolution rule + -E -s -B -X utf8), radios_platform_spawn_helper(const gchar *const *argv, const gchar *cwd, GError**) -> GSubprocess* (CREATE_NO_WINDOW, only pipe handles inherited), radios_platform_spawn_detached(const gchar *const *argv, const gchar *cwd, GError**) (CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP, breakaway fallback).

C radios_platform_executable_path(void) -> gchar* (GetModuleFileNameW, UTF-8), radios_platform_get_argv_utf8(void) -> gchar** (CommandLineToArgvW(GetCommandLineW())), radios_platform_wait_pid(guint32 pid, guint timeout_ms) -> gboolean, radios_platform_gui_stop_source_new(guint32 pid) -> GSource* (waits on Local\RadioS-GUI-<pid>).
